text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for Seiun Sky at the end of the summer camp—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the camp, she followed every instruction
faithfully, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nope, totally off. This is a secret strategy meeting! We wanna conquer the Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike last year,
she didn't offer any suggestions.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I went from first-rate
to ultra, ultra, ultra-first-rate!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine.
If you're out of it, you're the one who suffers, Sky-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Listen, I've honed my weapons to perfection.
Enough to defeat you at the Autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
How about you...?
Did you master your unorthodox ways even further this summer?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Who knows?
Trainer, I'm getting on the bus ahead of you~"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't tell me she's
lost her will to fight?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
She's been acting strange ever since the Takarazuka Kinen.
Could racing against Special Week and the others
have made her lose the will to run...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky has always overcome every wall
without ever giving up.
She certainly won't give up this time, either.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Whether it's across the back or on the cheek,
go give them a good, hard slap.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because you're
that girl's Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a summer training camp that left me with plenty of homework as a Trainer came to a close.
